declaration.preface:
First Quality Knitss, a division of Nectar Crafts, is deeply committed to integrating environmental sustainability into all aspects of its textile manufacturing operations. As part of a globally recognized company known for ethical practices and certified under standards like ISO 14001, GOTS, GRS, and OEKO-TEX, First Quality Knits adopts a proactive approach to environmental responsibility. We prioritize the efficient use of natural resources, reduction of greenhouse gas emissions, proper treatment and disposal of effluents, and minimization of waste generation throughout our production processes.

Our commitment extends to sourcing sustainable raw materials, using eco-friendly packaging, and promoting cleaner production technologies. This Environmental Policy outlines our dedication to continual improvement, regulatory compliance, and stakeholder engagement. By fostering environmental awareness among employees and aligning with international sustainability frameworks, First Quality Knits aims to deliver high-quality knitted garments while protecting the environment and contributing to a greener future.
declaration.declaration: First Quality Knits, a division of Nectar Crafts, is committed to conducting its operations in an environmentally responsible manner. We pledge to minimize our environmental impact by complying with all applicable legal and regulatory requirements, conserving natural resources, reducing emissions and waste, and promoting sustainable practices across our value chain. Through continuous improvement, stakeholder engagement, and adherence to recognized environmental standards, we aim to protect the environment, support climate resilience, and contribute to a more sustainable textile industry. This policy reflects our dedication to responsible growth and is integral to our business strategy and day-to-day operations.
declaration.scope: This Environmental Policy applies to below given operational areas of First Quality Knitts, a division of Nectar Crafts, including fabric processing, garment manufacturing, packing, dispatch, utility operations, waste management, and chemical handling. It extends to all employees, contract workers, sub-contractors, and relevant stakeholders involved in our operations.

Energy Efficiency & Emission Reduction: Adopting energy-efficient machinery and optimizing production processes to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and lower our overall carbon footprint.

To implement energy-saving technologies such as LED lighting, energy-efficient sewing and pressing machines, and high-efficiency motor. Conduct regular energy monitoring to optimize usage across all garment production units.
To involve all employees in energy conservation by promoting behavioral change, shutting down idle equipment, and encouraging use of energy-efficient practices.
Water Conservation & Management: Implementing water-saving measures across production, promoting reuse and recycling of water, and ensuring responsible treatment of wastewater.
Optimize water recycling and reuse to reduce freshwater intake and implement advanced water treatment technologies to enhance sustainability.
Sustainable Materials & Chemical Managem: Prioritizing the use of certified sustainable fabrics and ensuring the safe handling, storage, and disposal of chemicals to minimize environmental and human health risks.
To prioritize the use of organic, recycled, and low-impact materials in garment manufacturing.
To strengthen responsible sourcing from suppliers certified under GOTS, GRS, and OCS.
To regularly assess supplier practices for environmental and ethical compliance.
To avoid hazardous substances and adhere to OEKO-TEX® Standard 100 or equivalent product safety standards.
Air Emission Control: Maintaining air quality by controlling emissions from ironing, finishing, and other production processes through appropriate ventilation and filtration systems.
Reduce air emissions by upgrading filtration, emission control systems and hence promote cleaner production methods to minimize atmospheric pollution.
Waste Reduction & Circular Practices: Reducing production waste, encouraging reuse of fabric offcuts, and promoting recycling practices throughout the value chain.
Minimize waste generation through process efficiency improvements and strength the recycling and material recovery process to support circular economy goals.
To engage 100% of employees in sorting and recycling programs to support a circular economy.
Product Use Sustainability: Designing garments that are durable, resource-efficient, and have a lower environmental impact throughout their lifecycle.
Enhance durability and recyclability of products to minimize waste and hence reduce the environmental impact of product.
To develop long-lasting, recyclable garments using low-impact materials, to maintain the goal of elimination of 100% of harmful chemicals in products.
Product End-of-Life Stewardship: Supporting initiatives that encourage garment recycling, reuse, and responsible disposal practices post-consumer use.
Establish product take-back and recycling initiatives for responsible disposal.
Collaborate with customers to ensure sustainable product end-of-life management.
Customer Health & Safety: Ensuring all products are free from harmful substances, meet applicable safety standards, and support safer use by end consumers.
Ensure 100% compliance with all product safety and environmental regulations through regular product testing.
Maintain zero customer complaints related to product safety.
Maintain zero product-related environmental incidents annually.
Ecosystem & Biodiversity Consideration: Operating in a manner that minimizes disruption to local ecosystems and promotes biodiversity through responsible resource use and waste disposal.
Minimize land-use impact by implementing eco-friendly site management and supporting afforestation and biodiversity conservation projects.
Innovation for Sustainability: Investing in innovative, eco-friendly technologies and process improvements to continually enhance our environmental performance and product sustainability.
Invest in R&D for developing eco-friendly products, processes and hence develop sustainable alternatives.
Environmental Engagement & Advocacy: Promoting environmental awareness and best practices within the industry and local communities, supporting partnerships, education initiatives, and advocacy efforts that contribute to a more sustainable textile sector.
Train all employees on sustainability and environmental regulations annually.

policy.monitoring: First Quality Knits is committed to maintaining transparency and accountability in its environmental performance through a structured monitoring and reporting framework. Key environmental data, including energy usage, greenhouse gas emissions, water consumption, chemical use, and waste generation, will be systematically tracked, recorded, and evaluated. Regular internal assessments and audits will be conducted to ensure compliance with applicable environmental regulations and company sustainability objectives. Performance will be reviewed against established Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and outcomes will be reported to senior management and relevant stakeholders.
policy.reviewMechanism: This Environmental Policy will be reviewed annually by the Environmental Manager to ensure its relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with evolving sustainability goals, legal requirements, and industry best practices. Feedback from internal audits, employee input, and stakeholder engagement will be considered in each review cycle. Necessary revisions will be implemented to strengthen our environmental commitments and improve overall performance. All updates or significant changes will be clearly communicated across all levels of the organization to ensure continued awareness, ownership, and compliance.
